clauses.text: This Tenancy Agreement is entered into on 10 September 2026 between Mrs. S. Iyer ("Landlord") and Mr. K. Thomas ("Tenant") for the residential premises at No. 12, 3rd Cross, Jayanagar, Bengaluru.
clauses.explanation: Standard clause; no risk indicators found.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: The tenancy shall be for a period of twelve (12) months starting 1 October 2026. The Tenant shall have the option to renew the tenancy for a further twelve months on the same terms, subject to the rent increase in clause 2.3.

findings.title: Renewal at your option
findings.explanation: You decide whether to renew, which gives you security of tenure.
findings.evidence: Tenant shall have the option to renew

clauses.explanation: You decide whether to renew, which gives you security of tenure.

clauses.heading: Rent
clauses.text: The monthly rent is Rs. 30,000, payable by bank transfer on or before the 5th of each month.
clauses.explanation: Standard clause; no risk indicators found.

clauses.heading: Rent
clauses.text: The Landlord shall issue a written receipt for every payment received.

findings.title: Rent receipts provided
findings.explanation: You get written proof of each payment.
findings.evidence: Landlord shall issue a written receipt

clauses.explanation: You get written proof of each payment.

clauses.heading: Rent
clauses.text: On renewal, the rent may be increased by not more than 5% of the rent last paid.

findings.title: Rent increase is capped
findings.explanation: Any increase is limited to a stated maximum, so future rent is predictable.

clauses.explanation: Any increase is limited to a stated maximum, so future rent is predictable.

clauses.heading: Security Deposit
clauses.text: The Tenant shall pay a refundable security deposit of Rs. 60,000.
clauses.explanation: This clause adds protection for you as the tenant.

clauses.heading: Security Deposit
clauses.text: The deposit shall be refunded within fifteen (15) days of the Tenant handing over vacant possession, less any amounts for damage beyond normal wear and tear, supported by an itemised statement with bills.

findings.title: Clear refund deadline
findings.explanation: The deposit has a defined return deadline, which protects you from indefinite delays.

findings.title: Deductions must be justified
findings.explanation: Any deduction must be backed by an itemised statement or receipts, so you can check what you are charged for.

clauses.explanation: The deposit has a defined return deadline, which protects you from indefinite delays. Any deduction must be backed by an itemised statement or receipts, so you can check what you are charged for.

clauses.heading: Repairs and Maintenance
clauses.text: The Tenant shall carry out minor day-to-day repairs such as replacing bulbs and fuses.
clauses.explanation: Standard clause; no risk indicators found.

clauses.heading: Repairs and Maintenance
clauses.text: The Landlord shall carry out all major and structural repairs, including roof, plumbing lines and wiring, within a reasonable time of being informed.

findings.title: Landlord handles major repairs
findings.explanation: The landlord is responsible for major or structural repairs, as is standard.
findings.evidence: Landlord shall carry out all major and structural repairs

findings.title: Repairs within a deadline
findings.explanation: The landlord must fix problems within a set time, and you have a remedy if they don't.
findings.evidence: Landlord shall carry out all major and structural repairs, including roof, plumbing lines and wiring, within

clauses.explanation: The landlord is responsible for major or structural repairs, as is standard. The landlord must fix problems within a set time, and you have a remedy if they don't.

clauses.heading: Repairs and Maintenance
clauses.text: The Tenant shall keep the premises in good condition, normal wear and tear excepted.

findings.title: Normal wear and tear excluded
findings.explanation: You aren't charged for ordinary ageing of the property.

clauses.explanation: You aren't charged for ordinary ageing of the property.

clauses.heading: Late Payment
clauses.text: If rent remains unpaid seven days after the due date (grace period), a one-time late fee of Rs. 500 shall be payable.

findings.title: Grace period for payment
findings.explanation: You get extra days to pay before any penalty applies.

clauses.explanation: You get extra days to pay before any penalty applies.

clauses.heading: Access
clauses.text: The Landlord may enter the premises for inspection or repairs with at least 24 hours prior written notice to the Tenant, except in an emergency.

findings.title: Entry only with notice
findings.explanation: The landlord must give advance notice before entering, protecting your privacy.

clauses.explanation: The landlord must give advance notice before entering, protecting your privacy.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement by giving one month's written notice to the other party.

findings.title: Mutual termination rights
findings.explanation: Both sides can end the agreement on the same terms, so neither party has an unfair advantage.

clauses.explanation: Both sides can end the agreement on the same terms, so neither party has an unfair advantage.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: The Landlord may terminate the tenancy earlier only if the Tenant fails to pay rent for two consecutive months or materially breaches this agreement, after giving thirty days' written notice to remedy the breach.

findings.title: Landlord can end it only for a reason
findings.explanation: The landlord can only end the tenancy for a real breach, and you get a chance to fix it first.
findings.evidence: Landlord may terminate the tenancy earlier only if

clauses.explanation: The landlord can only end the tenancy for a real breach, and you get a chance to fix it first.

clauses.heading: Use of Premises
clauses.text: The premises shall be used for residential purposes only. The Tenant shall not sublet the premises without the Landlord's written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

findings.title: Consent can't be unreasonably refused
findings.explanation: The landlord must have a good reason to say no, which keeps the permission process fair.

clauses.explanation: The landlord must have a good reason to say no, which keeps the permission process fair.

clauses.heading: Use of Premises
clauses.text: The Tenant may keep one domestic pet.

findings.title: Explicit freedom of use
findings.explanation: The agreement confirms things you are allowed to do, avoiding later disputes.

clauses.explanation: The agreement confirms things you are allowed to do, avoiding later disputes.

clauses.heading: Liability
clauses.text: Each party shall be responsible only for loss or damage caused by its own negligence or breach of this agreement.

findings.title: Liability limited to fault
findings.explanation: Responsibility depends on who was actually at fault, which is fair to both sides.

clauses.explanation: Responsibility depends on who was actually at fault, which is fair to both sides.

clauses.heading: Utilities
clauses.text: Electricity and water charges as per meter readings shall be paid by the Tenant. Property tax shall be paid by the Landlord.
clauses.explanation: Standard clause; no risk indicators found.

clauses.heading: Disputes
clauses.text: Any dispute shall first be discussed in good faith, failing which either party may approach the Rent Authority or competent court.
clauses.explanation: This clause adds protection for you as the tenant.
